dimensions.assessment: Affects residents, landowners, and visitors within the newly included counties in Virginia and West Virginia, plus management entities and local partner organizations.
dimensions.evidence: Rockbridge County, Virginia; Berkeley, Jefferson, and Morgan Counties, West Virginia

dimensions.assessment: Provides dedicated federal funding authorization of $1.25 million annually plus $2.5 million annually for specific fiscal years for grants and land acquisition.
dimensions.evidence: for fiscal year 2027 and each fiscal year thereafter, $1,250,000 to the management entity

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes specific federal appropriations totaling millions of dollars per year for district operations, maintenance, and grants.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033, $2,500,000 for grants and technical assistance... and acquisition

dimensions.assessment: Expands geographic boundaries across state lines and establishes specific funding and reporting mandates for the district partnership model.
dimensions.evidence: expand the boundaries of the Shenandoah Valley Battlefields National Historic District, to recognize and enhance... the partnership model

dimensions.assessment: Provides ongoing baseline annual authorizations starting in fiscal year 2027, with multi-year grant and land acquisition authorizations running through fiscal year 2033.
dimensions.evidence: for fiscal year 2027 and each fiscal year thereafter, $1,250,000... and for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033, $2,500,000

importance_detail.rationale: Expands the boundaries of the Shenandoah Valley Battlefields National Historic District into West Virginia and Rockbridge County, Virginia, and authorizes annual appropriations for operations, grants, and land acquisition.

card.summary: The Shenandoah Valley Battlefields National Historic District Boundary Expansion and Partnership Act of 2026 expands the geographic boundaries of the Shenandoah Valley Battlefields National Historic District into new counties in Virginia and West Virginia, updates its administration, authorizes specific appropriations, and requires a report on replicating its partnership model.
